hooks.prompt: Check if the assistant showed the Julia code to the user before calling eval. The code can be displayed as a fenced ```julia block, inline `code`, or clearly described in the message. If the code is visible to the user in any readable form, respond with nothing. Only respond with a warning if eval is called with NO prior mention of the code at all: 'Show Julia code to the user before calling eval so they can review it.'

If the file just written or edited ends in .jl (a Julia source file) and a Julia REPL session is active (i.e., you have previously called eval, session, or any julia-repl MCP tool in this conversation), call the revise MCP tool with action='revise' to hot-reload the changes into the active Julia session. This preserves session state and avoids needing a reset. Do NOT call revise for non-.jl files or if no Julia session has been started yet.
